heroTitle: A discreet manufacture, in service of the right gesture
heroSubtitle: "We do not make boxes. We give a case to what matters."
storyImageAlt: Noble wood grain worked in the workshop

story.title: Our Story
story.lead1: Our manufacture has existed for fifteen years. Until now, it has crafted exceptional cases and presentation boxes on behalf of major luxury houses, under confidentiality agreements that bind us never to name them — a discretion that is part of our craft.
story.lead2: L'Écrin Français is the brand we are creating to diversify: opening this same manufacture, the same craftsmen and the same standard of finish, directly to individuals and small businesses — without going through a third-party house.
story.lead3: Nothing is produced on an assembly line. Every case is still made to order, on a deliberately non-automated line: this is what guarantees the authenticity of each piece, whether it's a single commission or a series.
story.lead4: Allow around a month between the confirmation of your order and delivery — the time genuinely hand-made work requires, not the pace of a factory.

card1.title: Full-Circle Craftsmanship
card1.text: From selecting the wood essence to fitting the last hinge, no step is blindly outsourced: we remain responsible for every gesture.

card2.title: Exacting Bespoke Work
card2.text: Millimetre-precise dimensions, hot-stamped or laser engraving, choice of materials: every case is redesigned for the object it will hold, never the other way round.

card3.title: From a Single Piece to a Series
card3.text: An exceptional gift or a collection destined for a distribution network: the same standard of finish applies, whatever the quantity — with tiered pricing for volume orders.

gallery.image1Alt: Open wooden case with a watch and jewellery inside
gallery.image1Caption: Jewellery & watches: the case shaped around the object it protects.
gallery.image2Alt: Hands shaping wood with a chisel
gallery.image2Caption: Every gesture matters — the precision of a chisel before the final finish.

process.title: The Making Journey
process.intro: Every order follows the same path, from the first conversation to delivery — allow around a month, the time genuinely artisanal work requires.

step1.title: Listening & Measuring
step1.text: We take the time to understand the object to be protected and the intended use of the case.

step2.title: Choice of Materials
step2.text: Wood essence, lining, tint: every material is selected for how it holds up over time.

step3.title: Shaping in the Workshop
step3.text: Cutting, assembly and fitting are carried out by hand by our craftsmen, in Portugal.

step4.title: Finishing & Engraving
step4.text: Lacquering, velvet, personalised engraving: the final touch that makes every piece unique.

step5.title: Inspection & Delivery
step5.text: Every case is inspected piece by piece before being packed with the same care as its contents.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.text: No piece leaves the workshop without passing our quality control.

discretion.title: Discretion
discretion.text: We learned this craft behind the scenes, in the service of luxury houses that demand confidentiality — and we keep that same discretion today for our own clients.

surMesure.title: Bespoke
surMesure.text: No fixed catalogue: every project starts from a blank page.

durabilite.title: Durability
durabilite.text: Noble materials and assemblies conceived to last generations.

cta.title: Wish to entrust us with your project?
cta.lead: The online configurator covers most projects. For a specific request it can't yet compose, write to us directly: your message goes straight to the manufacture.
